life_update_deliveries_audience_box_chec.name: life_update_deliveries_audience_box_check
life_update_deliveries_audience_box_chec.value: ("paldora"."life_update_deliveries"."audience" = 'box' and "paldora"."life_update_deliveries"."box_id" is not null) or ("paldora"."life_update_deliveries"."audience" = 'only_me' and "paldora"."life_update_deliveries"."box_id" is null)

media_assets_purpose_box_check.name: media_assets_purpose_box_check
media_assets_purpose_box_check.value: ("paldora"."media_assets"."purpose" in ('avatar', 'life_update_image', 'room_banner') and "paldora"."media_assets"."box_id" is null) or ("paldora"."media_assets"."purpose" in ('post_image', 'reaction_image') and "paldora"."media_assets"."box_id" is not null)

posts_content_state_check.name: posts_content_state_check
posts_content_state_check.value: ("paldora"."posts"."status" = 'active' and char_length("paldora"."posts"."content") between 0 and 5000) or ("paldora"."posts"."status" = 'deleted' and "paldora"."posts"."content" = '')
